role: Independent intermediate Windows geometry and raw RGB coverage; document acceptance still uses unchanged platform references.
extraction: Private native probe reads the exact caller-named unchanged face 0, with no installed font lookup. Full RGB texture bytes are retained; no native probe is shipped.
mode: NATURAL_SYMMETRIC; NATURAL measuring; enabled grid fitting; CLEARTYPE_3x1 texture.

queryProfile.qualification: Original CC0 TrueType query fonts measured each selector independently in fpgm, prep and glyph programs. All three phases agreed. Unhinted masks do not qualify interpreter queries.

pointExtraction: Original Noto coordinates, flags, contour ends and fpgm/prep/CVT/hmtx retained. After the original A glyph program, GC[0] reads each X or Y coordinate; a reporter translates all points by that integer pixel count. All 36 resulting cropped RGB buffers equal the original bytes. Subtracting bounds recovers the 18 fitted F26 point positions.

lcdSampling.qualification: Independent CC0 square/edge fonts and eight separate cell configurations distinguish normalized integer weights from rounded byte weights. The computed A mask matches every retained RGB byte.

preblend.rgbToGray: Floor of integer RGB mean before the correcting table.
preblend.qualification: Pinned Skia font-mask transfer; unchanged selected Windows reference matches through all six raw and six prepared APIs.

limits: Qualifies the selected A geometry, mask and complete output. Other retained sizes, curves, colors, fractional placement and composites keep their own acceptance outcomes; this is not a universal font rasterizer qualification.
